who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane instances (V15) under proofs-1113
what: A fixture coercing `&S` to `&dyn Shape` is refused as `a function that does not type-check`, not by the translator, because minicore without `unsize, coerce_unsized` cannot type the coercion; the dyn refusal had to be tested with `g::<dyn Shape>()`. The `if_pos`/`if_neg` deprecation trap of stdmodels-1 cost a lake round again.
cause: a refusal test whose fixture fails before the translator gives a refusal that names the fixture, not the rule
whys: refused() accepts any NotTranslated; type-check and borrow-check refusals share the type with translator ones; nothing flags a refusal test that stopped before the translator
class: refusal tests that pass or fail for a reason other than the rule they test
prevention: not done: have refused() reject the `does not type-check` and `borrow checker did not accept` outcomes so a fixture error fails loudly
workaround: read the refusal text of each new case once
